text:
I like it. I actually prefer the look of the .... I received this item through vine. Although, I received the black and chrome rack instead of the white one, I like it. I actually prefer the look of the black and chrome versus the white. Most of my spice bottles fit. I like the way the drawers slide out and down to be able to see the bottles in each drawer.

It doesn't feel really heavy duty, but for the price, it's not bad. I would recommend to a friend.

product_metadata.title: YouCopia Original SpiceStack 18-Bottle Spice Organizer with Universal Drawers, White
features: Store and organize 18 full-size or 36 half-size spice bottles (not included); fits round AND square bottles
Drawers pull out and lower to display spices for easy location and reach. Non-skid feet hold unit securely in place
Compact unit saves valuable counter/cabinet space; NO installation or mounting. Care and cleaning-wipe clean with a damp cloth
Includes 96 (48 printed, 48 blank) removable drawer labels for custom organization
CONFIRM YOUR CABINET SIZE BEFORE YOU ORDER; Fits into standard cabinets; Measures 8-3/4" H x 10-7/8" D x 8-1/8" W; White
description: The Original SpiceStack holds 18 full-size or 36 half-size spice bottles neatly out of sight in the kitchen cabinet. Turn a jumbled pile of spices into an organized system that fits in just over 8" of cabinet space. This spice rack has three drawers that pull straight out and lower to resting position so you can find and reach your spices in a snap. Patented drawer design accommodates both round and square bottles. Includes 48 pre-printed and 48 blank drawer labels for custom organization. Nonslip feet and stackable. Stop looking and get cooking with the SpiceStack!
